title: About
text:
Hi, I’m Sana Shaik!
I was born in Hyderabad, India. I have pursued my academic journey with a deep interest in both technology and business. I completed my B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from GNITS, JNTUH, followed by an MBA from Aackba, OSMANIA UNIVERSITY. Currently, I am pursuing my Master’s in Data Analytics Engineering at George Mason University,USA.
With a unique blend of technical and business education, I am passionate about exploring how data can drive decision-making and innovation. My goal is to harness data insights to make a significant impact in the field of analytics.
In addition to academics, I enjoy learning about the latest trends in technology and data science, and I’m excited to work on projects that bring meaningful insights to life.

title: Sana Shaik
text:
Data Analytics Engineer

I build data-driven solutions using Python, R, SQL, machine learning, visualization, and AI-powered analytics. My work focuses on transforming complex data into clear insights for business, risk, compliance, and decision-making.

I am a Data Analytics Engineering graduate student at George Mason University with a background in Computer Science, Business Administration, and HR Operations. My experience combines technical analytics, business process understanding, and people-centered leadership.
I am interested in building practical analytics solutions that support decision-making in areas such as AI-driven data analysis, machine learning, fraud analytics, KYC/AML compliance, business intelligence, and risk scoring. I enjoy working with data from raw preparation to final insights, including cleaning, modeling, visualization, and communicating results clearly.




KYC intelligence, credit risk prediction, crime analytics, disaster analysis, restaurant revenue forecasting, and ML classification.



Python, R, SQL, Snowflake, AWS, PySpark, machine learning, data visualization, KYC/AML analytics, and compliance reporting.



Teaching, technical lab support, HR operations, team leadership, compliance support, payroll, and organizational management.



Graduate coursework in data mining, statistics, machine learning, big data, fraud examination, marketing analytics, and operations research.



Open to Data Analyst, Data Analytics Engineer, AI Analyst, Business Analyst, Fraud Analytics, and KYC/AML Analytics roles.
